page.layout: One page of verse, one text block in the centre; running head at the top with page number 80 at left; show-through from the reverse side (mirrored text) left out; no marginal notes.

main_text.p:
5. There Peace will goe to War,
And silence make a noise:
Where upper things will not
With nether equipoyse.

6. The upper world shall Rule,
While Stars will run their race:
The nether world obey,
While People keep their place.
main_text.head: The Clench.

p.i: IF any of these come out
So long's the world doe last:
Of what is said and past.

main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The page is a printed verse page; the stanzas beneath the Clench and FINIS are faint and largely unreadable. Lines marked illegible are the printed stanzas at lower left and in the lower text, and show-through from the reverse side is ignored. The large initial "I" of "IF" is the drop cap. Lines 7 to 9 are only partly legible and should be checked against the scan.
